decision_reason: The preregistered easy-router ceiling was 0.35. A leave-one-trajectory-out nearest-centroid router using adaptation-available length, session, amplitude and normalized-histogram summaries reached 0.361111; the threshold is not changed after observation.

dataset.reuse: The existing archive and extraction are reused in place; no redownload and no second 4.44 GB copy.

observable_interface.candidate_visible_metadata: anonymous file boundaries and ten numeric channels only
observable_interface.forbidden: source names/paths, fault, severity, speed, trajectory, drone, repetition, timestamps, reference trajectory, position, height, battery and flight mode
observable_interface.normalization: Per-channel mean/std from train anchors only; variance floor 1e-8; no test refit, clipping or imputation.

proposed_split.unit: whole MAT file identified by source SHA-256
proposed_split.train_healthy: D1, t1/t2/t3/t5, both speeds and all three repetitions
proposed_split.leakage_guards: No file or window crosses roles. D2/D3 healthy files are diagnostic-only. All t4 files stay adversarial. The candidate never receives factor labels or original names.

proposed_prediction_contract_if_reconsid.one_unchanged_learner: Fit anonymous per-train-file ridge ARX operators from 32-sample histories of ten channels to the next six state values; learn one rank-12 SVD basis of flattened operators; fit only basis coefficients from 32 adaptation anchors on each unseen file.
proposed_prediction_contract_if_reconsid.rollout_control: The evaluator supplies future four-channel motor commands identically to all controlled-dynamics models; predicted state is recursively fed back. Future sensor targets remain hidden.
proposed_prediction_contract_if_reconsid.anchors: Central 80% only; 128 deterministic train anchors/file, 32 adaptation anchors from the first fifth, and 128 seed-realized evaluation anchors from the remaining interval, with non-overlapping history/target windows.
proposed_prediction_contract_if_reconsid.status: design sketch only; no candidate was implemented because the gate rejected the protocol

mandatory_future_baselines.spec: pooled affine ridge one-step ARX, history 32, lambda 0.001, recursive rollouts
online RLS ARX, forgetting 1.0, initial covariance 1000 I, fixed update order
select the training-file ARX operator nearest to adaptation sufficient statistics without labels
fit the full operator from the held-out prefix with the candidate's source-identical feature/update code and no shared basis
one pooled ARX operator with no factorization or per-file coefficients
empirical Gaussian joint over history and next state, ridge 0.001, exact Gaussian conditioning
ridge-ARX conditional mean plus maximum-MI Chow-Liu tree over six Gaussian residual coordinates
mandatory_future_baselines.conformance: known three-node tree and conditional-density fixture

mandatory_future_baselines.spec: evaluator-labeled per-condition ARX with full acquisition/fit/query/state charge; privileged diagnostic
same-condition training equivalence supplied only by evaluator; upper bound excluded from implementable frontier

baseline_semantic_gate: Before any scoring, every mandatory baseline must have its exact ID, version, full specification, implementation path and SHA-256 plus passing conformance-test path and SHA-256. A missing/change-mismatched/nonconformant row stops before seed realization.

quality: mean and worst-flight normalized RMSE per channel for teacher-forced one-step and open-loop 10/50
conditional log loss where a density is defined
transfer: gain in all three test pairs and at least three of four trajectories
metrics_if_reconsidered.success: At least 2% NRMSE and 0.02 nats/target gain over the source-identical independent ablation, positive transfer in every held-out pair and at least three trajectories, at least 25% oracle-gap closure, and no Pareto domination by a simpler implementable baseline. One seed cannot promote.

identifiability_gate.verified_zlib_exception: F0_SV0_SP1_t3_D1_R1.mat has one incomplete trailer but an exact inner miMATRIX boundary and previously verified archive CRC/raw/numeric hashes.

scientific_status.confidence: 0.97 that the preregistered gate was executed faithfully; 0.65 that the excess routing signal is practically meaningful because it exceeds the ceiling by only 1/72.

exact_next_discriminating_step: In a later design-only wake, preregister an independent routing-sensitivity audit before execution: nested leave-one-trajectory-and-speed-out evaluation, permutation confidence interval, and a stricter candidate-visible feature audit. Do not migrate an evaluator, create HYP-0023/EXP-0058, implement a learner or score unless that new gate independently passes.
